case_name: State Of Madhya Pradesh v Kalyan Singh
respondent:
Kalyan Singh
Supreme Court of India

26 June 2008
CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.1062 OF 2003
The Order of the Court was as follows :
1.  This is a State appeal by special leave against the judgment dated 20.3.2001 of Madhya Pradesh High Court in Criminal Appeal No.447 of 1988 acquitting the respondent Kalyan Singh (Accused No.1) by giving him the benefit of doubt.
2.  The prosecution case in brief is that there was enmity between Balbir Singh, father of respondent and Jagdish (PW12) on account of Jagdish defeating Balbir Singh in the Sarpanch elections. On 18.3.1984, a day after the Holi festival, Jagdish as Sarpanch, invited the villagers for playing Faag at Panchayat Bhawan. One Barar, a member of Jagdish's group, was playing Dholak. Balbir Singh came there and tried to snatch the Dholak from Barar. Jagdish objected to Balbir trying to play Dholak at Faag function organized by him and tried to pull the Dholak. holding: The appeal has no merit and is dismissed accordingly.
